info.text: This is our product prototype made by Clint. It features a yellow and red color scheme, with yellow being our company color and red being more attractive.
The prototype design includes two basic shapes: a cycle and a triangle space, referred to as a mushroom design.
Key features of the prototype include a fancy and unique design, a circle channel selection, and a stable triangle base.
The circle channel selection allows users to turn a ball to select channels, providing a convenient alternative to traditional button-based selection.
The prototype includes a microphone and a button for broadening channels.
The channel selection feature allows for incremental changes, such as 1 to 10, 10 to 12, or 10 to 20 channels.
The electronics have been changed from a sample sensor to a regular chip.
There may be two versions of the product, with the first part being in the basic program.
The price of the product is 25 euros.
The product has been nicknamed the 'Pineapple remote control' or 'cute mushroom controller'.

summary: The prototype features a yellow and red color scheme with a mushroom design. Key features include a circle channel selection, stable triangle base, microphone, and button. The product allows for incremental channel changes and costs 25 euros. It's also nicknamed 'Pineapple remote control' or 'cute mushroom controller'.
